meaning_of_pass: The reviewed design is suitable for a separate freeze step. This is not a freeze, execution authorization beyond the parent task, a role result, or evidence of T4 effectiveness.
scope: Experiment files; allowed catalog-projection.json; selected cards and equipment-map entries only. No original catalog, sealed/holdout, prior role scripts, or broad repository search.

resolution_history.verified: Actual receiver input atoms are enumerated, deduplicated and hash-locked before viewing receiver output; quoted inclusion/exclusion evidence and denominator are retained. Fixed-ledger judgments, actual-input fidelity, claims, requests and per-response summaries are distinct. Faithful reproduction of sender misinformation can count as input fidelity but remains wrong end-to-end, inherited misinformation, and not a newly unsupported receiver claim.

GR/CV/CAU state and time/cutoff facts were separated. CAU actual receipt and content confirmation are separate unknown atoms. Rubric fixes contextual identity and partial-preservation rules without hidden partial credit. Final denominator is69 fact and27 unknown atoms.

Unchanged HPU know_how's unavailable catalog dependency is acknowledged; a reference is not permission to fetch and remembered specific relations are not input evidence. Normal/error examples distinguish unsupported concrete supply assignments, verification requests, general unit explanation and assigning the unobserved memo unit.

resolution_history.origin: Follow-up independent cross-check after initial-review preservation; tracked by author as R2_additional
resolution_history.initial_issue: PDP mandatory phase-voltage unknown and CV full/interlock names were available only in t4 support and could conflict with the strict unsupported-target rule in baseline conditions.
resolution_history.verified: Removed mandatory PDP phase-voltage atom; narrowed CV to generic signal state available in raw notes. Support-only details do not create mandatory fixed-ledger points or omissions. No raw memo or role packet was expanded.
Actual outer-prompt file path and actual packet UTF-8 bytes fields now support the protocol's logging requirements.

checks.static_verification_result: pass; run by independent reviewer after reading the script and confirming its read-only scope
checks.manual_semantic_review: All six memo sets and all fixed atom expected values inspected; no answer-like raw instruction or evaluation leakage identified. Support is the intended intervention, not incident evidence. Three-condition common values, selected know_how exact copies, actual template shape, fixed order and repeated cardinalities independently compared.
checks.other_design_requirements: Strict/sensitivity target-presupposition examples; general-unit boundary; new-information/receipt/reask/echo units; two-turn limit; length package-effect limitation; fresh fork_turns=none and one-read rules; observation-unavailable eligibility; stop/retry/missing rules; nonblinding limitations; and post-revision new-situation evaluation requirements remain explicit.

remaining_limitations: Synthetic development cases are authored with card knowledge and prior pilot limitations in mind, so six event groups are not an independent generalization set.
T4 support is400-463 Unicode characters versus91 for checklist and0 for none. The comparison estimates a content-plus-length package effect.

The HPU card's catalog reference remains an unavailable dependency in the role packet by design. This is a disclosed test limitation, not permission for external lookup or catalog-based incident claims.
Fresh contexts and tool rules are instruction controls, not OS isolation. Actual tool observability and eligibility must be recorded in execution.
Condition can be inferred from path/support phrasing and content. Full participant or evaluator blinding is not established.
Model snapshot, token cap, sampling configuration, actual usage and costs may be unavailable; reproducibility is limited to exposed settings and retained inputs/outputs.
A separate freezer must compute and verify the final manifest; future actual receiver packets depend on real sender output and cannot be pre-frozen as existing files.
This pass does not establish comparative effectiveness, validate all cards, or authorize claims about field operation, task resolution or independent generalization.
